title: Fix washed out colors on AMDGPU laptops
summary: Disable Panel Power Savings (PPS) which causes dim or washed-out colors on laptops when power-saving modes are active.
error_patterns: colors appear washed out and dim

steps.explain: Add the kernel parameter amdgpu.abmlevel=0 to disable Panel Power Savings.
steps.gui: Edit your bootloader configuration (e.g., GRUB) to add 'amdgpu.abmlevel=0' to the kernel command line.

rollback.explain: Remove the kernel parameter from the bootloader configuration.
rollback.gui: Edit your bootloader configuration to remove 'amdgpu.abmlevel=0'.

warnings: Disabling PPS may slightly increase battery consumption.
